name: Agate
overview: Scripture highlights agate as a precious and valued stone, frequently mentioned among other precious gems that symbolize beauty and divine craftsmanship. In Exodus 28:19, agate is listed as part of the high priest's breastplate, indicating its significance in holy service. Isaiah 54:12 portrays agates as materials used in the construction of God's restored people, symbolizing strength and splendor. Ezekiel 27:16 also includes agate among valuable trade goods, emphasizing its worth and desirability in ancient commerce.
